name: Cutie query-block integration gate
status: engineering gate only; no accuracy claim
method: At each native SAM2 memory cross-attention layer, form three prototypes by pooling spatial memory values using the stored predicted-mask labels. Use them as Cutie query tokens to update a low-resolution map formed from the native attention read and current SAM2 query. Reuse one official pretrained Cutie QueryTransformerBlock across SAM2 layers, freeze it, and train a shared feature bridge plus per-layer region queries and bounded residual scales. The zero-scale initialization must preserve native output exactly. Pointer keys and values remain in the untouched native SDPA call and are excluded from region prototypes.

checks: first frame is a positive-mask prompt
zero-scale predictions and stored memory are bit-identical to native SAM2
all four memory-attention layers are observed on every read
pointer counts are recorded and pointer tensors are never passed to the regional summarizer
one finite optimizer update per mode and finite nonzero gradients in each region query and shared feature bridge

decision: If the gate fails, stop before any PolypGen accuracy run and repair the implementation. Passing only establishes engineering compatibility; it does not justify a performance claim. Any later performance pilot must freeze the training and evaluation protocol first. All PolypGen outcomes remain exploratory because the dataset has informed earlier work.
